damping_modified_preparation.actual_UI_source_contract: Frozen helper sets t-damping and t-selective, dispatches ordinary bubbling change events, waits for engine-truth changes and synchronizes applicability from the engine. It preserves the original qualification anchor and asserts owner identity.
damping_modified_preparation.full_profile: All 46 canonical booleans exist. Baseline all false; only damping and selective_damping become true. Modified terms and suspended qualification match both measurement endpoints and both direct rows.
damping_modified_preparation.geometry_scope: Preparation records 12 particles; each measurement endpoint records 288 drawn vertices. This is the registered 12-marker proxy-box workload, not a 100-glyph worst case or an independently reconstructed microscopic damping field.
damping_modified_preparation.scientific_disposition: Engineering performance of an explicitly modified reference profile; no within-contract original-scenario, strict-law or recovered-physics approval.

lifecycle_and_overlay_coverage_limits: Direct WASM has null worker lifecycle records. Same owner, load generation, qualification and authoritative readiness remain checked.

The harness activates each available registered overlay through its real button, then performs ten paired toggle actions. The raw report does not retain per-overlay geometry for non-Damping views; passing does not prove every overlay had nonzero physical support.
Overlay visuals run through the main viewport path; the registered full-frame gate includes that work. Selected coordinator callback timings do not isolate every individual renderer operation.
Action latency is synchronous dispatch to the next foreground rAF, not a hardware display-present timestamp.
RAF subscriber, DOM, canvas and heap changes are coarse observations, not comprehensive reset/disposal or leak proofs.
